rubric_items.reason: All seven design components (CO-1 to CO-7) appear by name and each has at least one threat. The PII-bearing repo, service and route each have an information-disclosure threat.
Most threats fit their component: SQL in the subquery, a wider SELECT leaking medical history, reuse of the detail type. T-9 and T-10 are display-correctness defects given STRIDE labels.

Mitigations are either cited existing controls (paging, index, medical-history rule) or labelled new controls for implement. T-5 calls identify/requirePermission an existing control, but in the MVP they grant everything.
The MVP sign-in gap is stated as U-1 and asked as Q-01 to the tech lead with options and a default. Accepting PII exposure is marked non-blocking with the default 'accept'.
Body and frontmatter match and read clearly. Threats are ordered by component, not by risk.

findings.text: C12 cites a design-step IDE answer (A-11), but threat.md has no answers: list, so the cross-step answer cite will fail H4. The answer also only says 'lastVisitAt, ISO UTC'. It does not support the 'or null' part of the claim.

cites.quote: runs/run_01M6GRSJH8H42FGV284MDTDAZY/ide-answers.md#a-11
- answer: lastVisitAt, ISO UTC (proposed default)

findings.suggested_fix: Drop C12 or re-base it on a generated fact or context section. Keep T-10's string-or-null control as a new control for implement, without the cross-step answer cite.

findings.text: C6, C7 and C8 cite context/conventions.md and C10 cites context/generated/db-schema.json. Neither file is in the artifact's inputs list.

cites.quote: cites: ["context/conventions.md#lists"]
context/generated/db-schema.json#index:appointment_patient_start_idx

findings.suggested_fix: Add context/conventions.md and context/generated/db-schema.json, with their sha256, to inputs.

findings.text: T-5 lists identify/requirePermission as an 'Existing control' and puts T-5 under Known. In the MVP every permission is granted, so these functions do not stop spoofing. The real position is risk accepted pending Q-01.

cites.quote: Existing control: requests pass through identify and the route calls requirePermission
In the MVP every request is the actor `staff` and every permission is granted.

findings.suggested_fix: Reword T-5's mitigation as 'none in MVP; risk accepted pending Q-01 and sign-in'. Do not present identify/requirePermission as a protecting control.

findings.text: T-9 (wrong time zone) is labelled information_disclosure and T-10 (null type) is labelled tampering. Both are display-correctness defects with no attacker, so the STRIDE labels are forced.

cites.quote: Formatting in a zone other than the hospital zone would show a wrong day or time
A type that states lastVisitAt as always present would let a null reach dateTime

findings.suggested_fix: Recast T-9 and T-10 as integrity/tampering of displayed data with a clear actor, or drop them as non-security defects already covered by stories.

findings.text: Threats are listed by component, not by risk. The accepted MVP spoofing exposure (T-5) and the medical-history leak (T-2) do not lead the list.
